Phase 1 (chart builder + saved views) is behind the `dash_v2` flag and was due feature-complete by Dec 4 [1]. The design-partner beta then opens **Wednesday Dec 9** for 5 customers: Orbitly, Zest Grocers and three accounts from the October trial cohort [11][12].

Everyone else waits for general availability, targeted for late January, with a waitlist opening in January — so if another customer asks, don't promise access [11][12]. (The earlier spec said "4–6 design partners in early December" without a date [6], so Dec 9 is the newer, confirmed version.)
